home.sub: Phones, cars, furniture, solar panels and more, from people in your city.
home.emptyFiltered: Try a different word, a wider price range or another city.
home.emptyNone: Be the first to sell something here.

favorites.title: Saved listings
favorites.emptyBody: Tap the heart on a listing to keep it here and compare later.

notFound.title: This page took a wrong turn
notFound.body: The link may be old, or the listing was removed by its seller.

errorPage.title: Something went wrong
errorPage.body: The page could not be shown. Your connection may have dropped; nothing was lost.

auth.loginLead: Log in to message sellers, save listings and sell your own things.
auth.registerLead: Free, and it takes a minute. Then you can sell, save and chat.
auth.name: Your name
auth.consent: I accept the <terms>Terms of Use</terms> and have read the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
auth.consentRequired: Please accept the Terms and confirm that you have read the Privacy Policy.

listing.unavailableBody: It may have been sold and removed, or the link is incomplete.
listing.closed: This item is no longer available for enquiries.
listing.safety: Meet in a public place, check the item before you pay, and never send money in advance.

quick.whereWhen: Where and when can I see it?

listing.deleteBody: It disappears from search right away. Your chats about it are kept.
listing.deleteBodyNamed: {title} disappears from search right away. Your chats about it are kept.
listing.pendingReview: Under review: this listing is not public yet. A moderator will check it shortly.

photos.help: {n} of {max} photos. The cover is shown in search results. Large photos are resized on your phone before they are sent, to save data.
photos.wrongType: Only JPEG, PNG or WebP photos can be added
photos.tooMany: A listing can have up to {max} photos
photos.coverFailed: Could not change the cover photo

form.categoriesFailed: Could not load the categories. Check your connection.
form.title: Title
form.titleHint: What is it? Brand, model, size. Arabic or English.
form.priceHint: Enter 0 to give it away for free
form.descriptionHint: Age, defects, what is included, where to pick it up.

create.title: Sell something
create.photosLead: Listings with photos get far more replies. Show the whole item, then any defects.
create.liveBody: “{title}” can now be found by buyers. You will see their messages under Chats.
create.heldNotice: This listing will be checked by a moderator before buyers can see it. You can add photos in the meantime.
create.heldBody: “{title}” mentions something from our list of restricted items, so a moderator will check it before it goes live. You will find it under My listings.
create.heldRules: See what may not be offered

edit.title: Edit listing
edit.notYoursBody: Only the seller can edit it.
edit.locked: This listing was removed by moderation and can no longer be changed.
edit.deleteLead: Sold it elsewhere or changed your mind?
edit.held: This listing is under review and not public yet. A moderator will approve or remove it; you can still edit it.
edit.heldRules: See what may not be offered
edit.savedHeld: Saved. The listing is under review before it goes live.
edit.savedReleased: Saved. Your listing is live again.

my.title: My listings
my.emptyBody: Take a photo, set a price, and your listing is live in a minute.
my.emptyTabBody: Listings move here when you change their status.

inbox.title: Chats
inbox.emptyBody: Message a seller from any listing and the conversation shows up here.

chat.sendFailed: Message not sent. Check your connection.

profile.noListingsBody: {name} has nothing for sale at the moment.
profile.noReviewsBody: Buyers and sellers can review each other after chatting about a listing.

reset.forgotLead: Enter the email address of your account and we will send you a link to set a new password.
reset.sentBody: If an account exists for this email address, we have sent a link to reset the password.
reset.sentHint: The link is valid for 60 minutes and can be used once. No email? Check the spam folder, or try again with the address you registered with.
reset.resetLead: Choose a new password for your account. You will be logged out on all devices.
reset.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
reset.done: Password changed. Log in with your new password.
reset.invalidBody: The reset link is invalid, was already used, or has expired. Links are valid for 60 minutes.

legal.heading: Legal

description.terms: The agreement between you and {site}: accounts, listings, deals between users, moderation and liability.
description.privacy: Which personal data {site} processes, why, for how long, and your rights under the GDPR.
description.rules: What may not be offered on {site}, how to meet safely, and what happens when you report something.
description.imprint: Provider identification and contact details for {site}.

legal.draftBody: This text has not been checked by a lawyer yet, and the highlighted details still have to be filled in.

account.title: Account settings
account.profileLead: Your name and bio are shown on your public profile. Your phone number is never shown to others.
account.phoneHint: Optional, in international format, for example +963933123456.
account.passwordLead: Changing your password logs you out on all other devices.
account.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
account.dataLead: Download a copy of everything your account holds: profile, listings, favorites, conversations, reviews and reports, as a JSON file.
account.exportStarted: Your data file has been downloaded
account.dangerLead: Deletes your account and your listings for good. This cannot be undone.

gone.profile: Your email address, username, name, phone number and bio
gone.listings: All your listings and their photos
gone.favorites: Your saved listings and the reviews you wrote

stays.messages: Messages you sent stay visible to the person you wrote to, shown as from a deleted user
stays.reports: Reports you filed, as part of our moderation records

account.deleteExportFirst: If you want a copy of your data, download it first.

report.lead: Tell us what is wrong with {name}. Your report goes to our moderators; the other person is not told who reported them.
report.detailsHint: Optional. What should the moderators know?
report.rulesNote: See the <rules>Community Rules</rules> for what is not allowed.
report.sentBody: A moderator will look at it. If the rules were broken, the listing is removed or the account suspended.
report.duplicateBody: Your earlier report is still open and our moderators are looking at it. There is no need to send it again.

admin.title: Moderation
admin.forbiddenBody: Your account does not have access to the moderation tools. If you think it should, ask an administrator.
admin.actionFailed: The action could not be completed
admin.reasonHint: Required. It is saved in the moderation log.

reports.emptyOther: There are no reports with this status.
reports.openOnTarget: {count, plural, one {{n} open report} other {{n} open reports}}

resolve.title: Resolve this report?
resolve.body: Marks the report about {name} as handled. Use this after you have dealt with it.

dismiss.title: Dismiss this report?
dismiss.body: Closes the report about {name} without action, because no rule was broken.

removeListing.title: Remove this listing?
removeListing.body: {name} disappears for everyone except its seller, who can no longer change it. Open reports about it are resolved.

suspendUser.title: Suspend this user?
suspendUser.body: {user} is logged out and can no longer log in. All their listings are hidden. Open reports about them are resolved.

reactivateUser.title: Reactivate this user?
reactivateUser.body: {user} can log in again and their listings become visible.

approveListing.title: Approve this listing?
approveListing.body: {name} goes live and buyers can find it.

held.lead: These listings matched a prohibited term and are hidden until a moderator decides.
held.emptyBody: New listings that match a prohibited term will wait here.

log.lead: Every moderation action, with who took it and why
